subject: Lane F complete: typed Gen5 telemetry + deterministic replay/completeness contract
SUBPROBLEM: Make Gen5 opening failures reconstructable from one exported trace: physical truth vs visual prediction, bounded correction/fallback, split-pane ownership/readiness, presentation milestones, requested/effective cadence, and recovery; make telemetry loss machine-detectable.
CURRENT_MECHANISM: Current main has DuoDiagnostics free-form field logging plus TransitionLab JSONL with monotonic clock conversion, hinge timing, immutable lease/presentation IDs, FrameTimeline and SurfaceControl present-fence probes. TransitionEvent/SessionWriter already declare/serialize several Gen5 fields, but current TransitionLab does not populate visualAngle/predictedAngle/predictionConfidence/predictionLeadNs/refreshRateHz/jank fields. TransitionLab only mirrors DuoDiagnostics category fold7-state; other useful Gen5/lifecycle categories are fragmented into text. DebugBundleUploader verifies ZIP SHA but exporter has no trace-completeness manifest.
DOMINANT_LIMITATION: Evidence fragmentation: schema placeholders + free-form text cannot deterministically answer what physical state was known, what virtual state was rendered/presented, which pane owned the visual, and why terminal release/fallback occurred. Queue drops can be counted internally but are not exported as machine-readable completeness proof.
DESIGN_SUMMARY: Add explicit openingAttemptId/visualGeneration identity; typed gen5-attempt-start, gen5-virtual-frame, gen5-pane-state, gen5-presentation-stage, gen5-recovery, gen5-attempt-end and telemetry-health rows; populate measured/visual/predicted angle, velocity/accel, sample+blackout age, prediction horizon/confidence, correction+slew clamp, reversal/fallback, semantic state, left/right pane owner+readiness, bridge lease/capture identity, requested/effective refresh + frame interval/deadline state, and normalized recovery class. Presentation stage enum is REQUESTED -> HOST_BOUND -> DRAWN -> COMMITTED -> PRESENTED -> NATIVE_FRESH -> TERMINAL_RELEASE. Add debug-manifest.json with per-session SHA/bytes/row counts/sequence gaps/drop totals/flush result/traceComplete. Strong conclusions must fail closed when traceComplete=false.
INVARIANTS: Telemetry is observation-only; virtual values never own semantic state/panel authority/handoff. No terminal release before NATIVE_FRESH. Right pane has no owner gap before native-right readiness. Old service epoch/generation outputs are fenced stale. Correction cannot exceed configured slew clamp. 120Hz request != effective cadence and 60Hz fallback is non-semantic. Recorder must never block render/semantic paths; drops mark trace incomplete.
EXECUTED_TESTS: Python syntax compile PASS. Deterministic validator PASS on 100,000 virtual-frame rows / 101,100 total rows across 100 attempts. Injected violations detected: event-sequence gap, slew-clamp exceed, release-before-native-fresh, right-pane continuity gap, unfenced old service epoch, cumulative tail-drop evidence. Requested120/effective60 trace passes semantics with warning. Artifact ZIP integrity PASS; package SHA256=9d04a2bd9205a863af7b42fa0a67ab1143ac9301a5fadc768bf1640d4f4b7655.
PASS_FAIL_SUMMARY: Lane F pure replay/completeness model PASS. Device/runtime telemetry overhead MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED. Current source coverage FAILS the complete Gen5 diagnostic contract because key structured fields are dormant/unpopulated and export completeness is not machine-readable.
HUMAN_FIELD_MATRIX_RESULT: 100k pure replay/fault-injection PASS. Physical slow/hesitant/stops, 30-70 oscillation, 300-1000ms blackout, launcher wallpaper-before-widgets, service/Shizuku/process loss and 60/120 device cadence remain MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED; the proposed schema defines the evidence each must emit.
PERFORMANCE_RESULT: Research-environment replay of 101,100 rows completed in 0.3264s; this is off-device validator performance only, not Android runtime overhead. No claim of Fold7 recorder overhead or Gen5 visual latency improvement is made by this lane.
REGRESSION_RESULT: No production code was changed. Gen4 closing/panel authority untouched. Validator explicitly treats 120->60 fallback as warning and incomplete trace as evidence-quality failure, never a semantic/runtime action.
CONTRADICTIONS: Main advanced during the work unit from bfbf5d68 to b9bee812. Narrow audit shows b9bee is support/workflow/payload staging; baseline runtime remains unchanged at that head. Staged Beta1 patch computes valuable gen5-virtual-hinge/gen5-refresh/gen5-split-pane values but emits them via free-form DuoDiagnostics, so Lane F remains needed. Separately, first Gen5 Beta1 application workflow run 36981087516 failed on a stale test-class filter; blocker routed separately.
RESIDUAL_RISKS: Actual per-vsync writer allocation/I/O overhead on Fold7; exact launcher/widget first-useful readiness oracle; process death may prevent a final health row, so export must combine sequence gaps + cumulative persisted/periodic drops + process-exit evidence; schema migration/backward compatibility; Beta vs debug trace-level policy.
FOLD7_VALIDATION_REQUIRED: After Gen5 runtime builds: 20 normal opens + 20 repeated 30-70 close/reopen cycles; natural/injected 300-1000ms angle blackout; truth reacquisition at large angle; effective 60 and requested 120 cadence; accessibility/Shizuku/process loss; wallpaper-before-widgets case. Export immediately, require traceComplete=true before using trace for strong conclusions, then correlate with video/field feel.
INTEGRATION_TOUCHPOINTS: TransitionEvent.kt; TransitionSessionWriter.kt; TransitionLab.kt; Gen5 virtual clock/PanelEngine frame callback; Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator or successor Gen5 coordinator; FoldOverlayService lifecycle/semantic joins; DebugBundleExporter.kt manifest; DuoApplication.kt process-exit normalization. Beta1 staged patch already computes most per-frame virtual values, so typed emission can reuse those values rather than recompute them.
ROLLBACK_FALLBACK: Feature/build-gate high-rate rows. If telemetry causes jank, disable per-vsync detail but retain BASIC attempt/boundary/recovery rows. Never block renderer on writer queue; on drop increment cumulative counter and mark trace incomplete. On export-flush timeout export available evidence with flushSucceeded=false. No telemetry-driven semantic decisions.
CHEAPEST_NEXT_DECISIVE_TEST: First fix the confirmed CI test-filter blocker so Gen5 Beta1 can build. Then add telemetry-only typed emission + export manifest without changing the visual algorithm and run one Fold7 debug sequence (20 normal + 20 oscillation cycles). One exported bundle should explain physical truth, virtual render, pane ownership, presented/native-fresh milestones, cadence and terminal reason with no free-form parsing.
MANAGER_QUESTIONS: Prefer follow-up telemetry-only patch immediately after Beta1 vs fold into Beta1 rerun? Recommend enabling BASIC typed boundary telemetry for Beta builds while keeping expensive full probes debug/explicit-test gated.
english_summary: The existing recorder is close, but Gen5's most important values are either dormant JSON fields or free-form text. I built and fuzzed a deterministic replay/completeness contract that turns those values into typed attempt/frame/pane/presentation/recovery evidence and makes data loss explicit. It passed 100k virtual-frame replay plus adversarial corruption tests. Main changed only by staging the Beta1 package; that staged patch still logs Gen5 values as text, so this telemetry follow-up remains valid. I also found the first Beta1 CI run is blocked by a stale test filter, not an algorithm/test failure.
